errors.text_span: 水平轴显示七个不同的语义依存关系类别
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows five different verbs (避免, 回避, 逃避, 躲避, 规避), not seven semantic dependency categories. The semantic dependency categories are shown in the legend.

errors.text_span: 七个不同的语义依存关系类别：避，回，逃，躲，规，规、规
errors.evidence: The chart displays five categories on the x-axis, not seven. The listed labels (避, 回, 逃, 躲, 规, 规, 规) are incorrect and incomplete versions of the actual labels (避免, 回避, 逃避, 躲避, 规避).

errors.text_span: 以上述类别“规”为例，数据值从11.00%到38.00%
errors.evidence: Assuming "规" refers to the last category "规避", the data range is incorrect. The highest value is for CONT at approximately 33% (not 38.00%), and the lowest values are for categories like eCOO and eSUCC, which are close to 2%, not 11.00%.

errors.text_span: 每个类别都表示了三种不同用的颜色
errors.evidence: This statement is nonsensical. Each category on the x-axis is a group of up to 11 bars, each with a different color corresponding to a legend item. A single color represents a single legend item across all groups, not three.
The legend item 'PAT' is represented by a grey bar, not a light blue one.
The legend item 'CONT' is represented by a dark blue bar, not a green one.
The legend item 'TIME' is represented by a dark green bar, not an orange one.
The legend item 'LOC' is represented by a medium blue bar, not a light purple one.
The legend item 'MEAS' is represented by a light grey bar, not a light greenish-yellow one.
The legend item 'eSUCC' is represented by a light purple/lavender bar, not a light blue one.
